text_block_list.text: It happened one day leading up to the first race of the Triple Tiara route, the Oka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go!
There's somewhere I want to take you!
choice_data_list: Alright, where do you want to go?
Yeah, where do you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You decide that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll just tell you the conditions for
"what kind of place I'd like."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
As my familiar, you're going to find a spot that
fits those conditions peeerfectly! Got it?!

And so, I brought her to a place that seemed to fit her criteria of
"a place full of flowers and overflowing with magic."
choice_data_list: (Was it okay to do it here...?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, looks like you've got a decent variety here.
Well, it's waaaay behind
Grandma's garden, though!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, familiar, keep up!
I've been thinking this for a while, but you know way too little about flowers.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"If you're Koi's familiar, you've
got to remember these things properly! Fufu♪"

"And after listening to her lecture on
the magical properties of flowers for a while—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ――...Hey, familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I knew it—I really think you're the one
who holds the first clue to finding racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Because to you, my running looks like 'magic', doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then after all, please tell me properly.
Put it into words.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do you feel
when you watch me run?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"—The you right now can definitely
give a different answer than before!"

"...Indeed, I truly had become
a 'high-ranking' familiar to her."

Before, I could only answer with, "I just kind of feel that way."
However, now I'm certain I can.
choice_data_list: Whenever I watch you run, I always—
Whenever I watch you run, I always—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah. What's up?
choice_data_list: Something new feels like it's about to begin — I'm getting all excited!
Something new is about to begin — I'm so excited!

text_block_list.text: As if to blow away and rewrite everything that had come before, bestowing whole new colors upon the world.

Whenever I watch her run,
that is always how I feel—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Isn't that the exact same thing?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(It's just like the feeling I get
whenever I watch Grandma's magic—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it! I knew it was true all along!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I know I can use it on you.
My 'racing magic' really works on you!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No way! My magic isn't even close to complete yet! Because I have to cast a spell over the whole entire world!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So――so that's right, it's an upgrade!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I have to make my magic way, way stronger!
Not just for my familiar, but strong enough
to reach everyone watching...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So, what am I supposed to do about that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, thinking so hard the whole time
is making me super hungry...!
Familiar, fetch me another stack of pancakes!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
…………Also.
If you think of anything,
just say it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're supposed to be the one I consult with!
I racked my brain as well. How could I enhance the racing magic that, for now, had only been cast on myself?

For instance—how about we take another look
at what the "magic of racing" truly is?

Yes, for example, when Sweep Tosho first sensed
the magic potential of racing—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, decided. I'll give running a shot.
I'll run for you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—I'm off to the Twinkle Series
to find magic!

Taking a genuine interest in the Twinkle Series for the first time,
she sensed the magical possibilities hidden within racing.
Surely, it was because the Twinkle Series was a "special" stage that endlessly excited and captivated both people and Umamusume alike.
If the true potential of racing's magic lies within that 'special quality'—!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A "special race"?
...What kind of race is that?
choice_data_list: Honestly, I don't know that for sure yet, but—

text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I told them that continuing like this gives us
a strong chance of finding the answer.
And that's because..."
choice_data_list: Our goal is the Oka Sho.
Our goal is the Oka Sho, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:
A chance that comes only once in a lifetime.
A race where Umamusume risk their pride, their souls, and every ounce of their strength.
To say that wasn't a special race...
choice_data_list: There's absolutely no way that's true!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmmmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, it's true that extremely powerful magic always comes with 'special' incantations and magic circles.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So――yep, I've decided!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do it, familiar.
On the Triple Tiara route, I'll run a "special" race and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm going to perfect the magic of racing!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Now, in this year's Oka Sho, which Uma Musume will claim the very first tiara?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: All the horse girls are now making their appearance in the paddock—!
